falsification_conditions.condition: Price breaks above the 200-day moving average with a volume spike exceeding 2x the 30-day average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed breakout would indicate a trend reversal, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal and suggesting a new phase (e.g., bullish acceleration).

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score increases to 70+ within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 70 would confirm a 'blowoff top' pattern, directly contradicting the current 'HOLD' and implying a bearish phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern match percentage to mini_top_2019_jun reaches 90% or higher
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A stronger pattern match would validate a specific historical scenario, forcing the verdict to align with the confirmed pattern (e.g., a confirmed top or bottom).

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
